title: Qualify the candidate and sustained performance on Android

scope: Candidate realtime-single-step-v1-fd78fa8 from F8-36 failed a required row and is rejected for qualification. acceptance: Run every applicable kernel/variant, domain, coupling, lifecycle and negative case in the frozen matrix; record unsupported and missing cases explicitly. All required rows must execute and pass.
